test_title: PYST 33: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 29th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78fa196b1df362cf0fb1ad60d60c0135dab00ddf63f12594accd02ce85724bb9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• Second, third, fourth line with symbol is rotated 180⁰ and moves one step upwards from figure to figure.
 
• Slant line with new symbol on left of the slant line is added on fourth position in figure 2, 3, 4, 5, 6. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/330ffdfc83684dfe7418b84246a9a0202c5c3eb9b424ad8f398efb93237253fd.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/039eca3802c4b3b0948fd45f39783475c51a578298606c2ea7c39710f99d3817.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
